# Cloudflare Workers

> Workers, routes, cron triggers, and the developer platform storage bindings (KV, D1, Queues, R2, Hyperdrive) plus Pages.

Terraform module for Cloudflare, maintained by CloudDrove. Source: `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare`. Repository: https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers

Requires Terraform >= 1.12.0 (or OpenTofu >= 1.12) and the `cloudflare/cloudflare` provider ~> 5.24. Provider v5 renamed most resources from v4, so verify resource names against the current provider docs rather than older examples.

## Usage

```hcl
module "this" {
  source  = "terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare"
  version = "~> 0.1"
}
```

## Submodules

Each is separately addressable with the double slash source syntax.

- [cron](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/cron): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/cron`
- [d1](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/d1): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/d1`
- [hyperdrive](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/hyperdrive): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/hyperdrive`
- [kv](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/kv): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/kv`
- [pages](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/pages): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/pages`
- [queue](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/queue): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/queue`
- [r2](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/r2): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/r2`
- [route](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/route): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/route`
- [script](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-workers/tree/main/modules/script): `terraform-cf-modules/workers/cloudflare//modules/script`
